title: Pensaci, Giacomino!
summary: "Pensaci, Giacomino!" by Luigi Pirandello is a comedy written in early 1916. An elderly, underpaid Sicilian professor devises an unconventional revenge against the state: he marries his young pregnant student, offering to support her, her child, and her lover under one roof. This scandalous arrangement defies social conventions and provokes outrage in their small town.
